name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It preserves fine details in low-light or noisy footage better than standard upscalers, which directly boosts EXCAVA’s output quality without extra compute. The trade-off is added pipeline complexity—we must integrate a new node and tune its depth sensitivity—but the 0.5%+ gain in usable frames justifies it.

name: Torque
text: InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop—it only sharpens edges, not facial features. RealVisXL’s latest face model is a moving target; its backward compatibility is unproven and risks breaking EXCAVA’s pipeline. Test RealVisXL’s v1.1 face model against EXCAVA’s worst-case footage—if face fidelity improves by 0.5% without new compute, it’s the better play.

text:

text: RealVisXL’s v1.1 face model still risks breaking EXCAVA’s pipeline—its backward compatibility claims are unproven under real-world video conditions, not just static tests.
